prompted_for: One measured figure (original of concept-n-readout; became Readout: instrument display with limit tag and tick scale)
composition: one gigantic figure filling the left two-thirds of a framed panel
unit set vertically beside the figure
label and limit tag stacked to the right
trend line chart across the bottom third
mobile panel stacks figure, unit, label, limit, mini chart
layout_devices: thin horizontal reference line cutting through the figure at mid-height and running to the limit tag
outlined limit tag 'spec limit' with status text under it
tick scale with numbered axis under the trend line
corner meta labels (channel id, timestamp) top and bottom
inner frame inset in the outer panel
palette: warm limestone off-white numerals and labels
muted steel-blue trend line, limit tag and status text
pale grey hairline frame and ticks
typography: huge tall condensed sans numerals, light-to-regular weight
condensed caps label in two lines
small monospace meta labels and axis figures
line_and_texture: 1 px pale frame lines with square corners
dense tick marks with taller major ticks
motion_implied: numerals count up or settle to the value
trend line draws left to right
limit line extends to the tag
t2i_keywords: thin horizontal reference line through the figure
tick scale axis with small numbers
desktop and mobile views side by side
t2i_prompt: Flat desktop UI mockup with a matching narrow mobile view, no device frame, no people. Very dark navy background, one framed panel styled like an instrument display. A single oversized figure in tall condensed off-white numerals fills two-thirds of the panel, its unit rotated beside it. A thin horizontal reference line cuts through the figure and runs to a small outlined steel-blue limit tag with status text. Below, a thin steel-blue trend line over a fine tick scale with small monospace axis numbers. Monospace channel and timestamp labels in the corners. <CONTENT> as the figure and label.
signature_idea: One measured value set huge like an instrument readout, with the specification limit drawn as a line straight through it.
strengths: one number with its unit and limit is exactly how the brand wants facts shown
huge type plus emptiness gives calm authority
reference line to the limit tag makes the margin legible at a glance
weaknesses: trend chart implies live monitoring data Aquemi may not have
timestamp and channel ids are decorative noise
condensed display face differs from Geist; would need re-setting
brand_fit_why: Navy and limestone with one steel-blue accent, light large numerals, mono figures, square corners and lots of space: close to the brand book's ideal of the number as hero.
